subject: Request: BYOK/HSM Evidence for FinCore SIG+SOC2 Review
messages:
From: audits@fincore.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Evidence request — FinCore SIG+SOC2: BYOK & HSM artifacts

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of FinCore's SIG + SOC2 evidence collection we're requesting artifacts related to Redwood's BYOK and HSM controls. Specifically we need: 

- HSM attestation/cert (latest) and the CA that issued it.
- Key rotation logs for all customer-managed keys (BYOK) for the past 12 months (CSV or exported logs).
- A short written statement confirming that BYOK key material is never exported in cleartext from an HSM (signed by a key owner).
- The current Key Management Policy and rotation schedule (what locks/thresholds trigger rotation).
- Access matrix showing who holds the "key_custodian" role and which Redwood services have wrap/unwrap privileges.
- Evidence of transport encryption (TLS versions/ciphers) for inter-service key operations.

Can you confirm an ETA for a package deliverable? If some items take longer we can accept staged delivery (e.g., deliverable 1: attestation + policy; deliverable 2: rotation logs). We prefer PDFs/CSV and a single ZIP if convenient.

Also let us know if any evidence is restricted — we can accept redacted versions where needed and will treat them under NDA.

Cheers,
Maria Garcia
Security Audit Lead
FinCore Systems
Attachment: fincore_request_checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: audits@fincore.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — FinCore SIG+SOC2: BYOK & HSM artifacts

Maria — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a package and aim for staged delivery as you suggested.

Planned items and owners:
- HSM attestation & CA chain (Irene) — deliverable 1.
- Key rotation logs (last 12 months) (Irene) — deliverable 2, CSV export from our KMS audit pipeline.
- BYOK non-export statement + Key Management Policy (Laura) — deliverable 1.
- Access matrix (roles & privileges) (Karthik) — deliverable 1, plus a short explanation of how wrap/unwrap is restricted.
- Transport encryption summary (cipher suites + TLS policy) (Karthik) — deliverable 1.

Target timeline: deliverable 1 by EOD Friday (2026-05-22), deliverable 2 (rotation logs) by EOB Monday (2026-05-25) if that works. If you need anything sooner or a different format, tell us.

We will provide a password-protected ZIP over the secure link and share the password separately.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
Attachment: delivery_plan.md (text)
From: irene.choi@redwood.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, audits@fincore.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — FinCore SIG+SOC2: BYOK & HSM artifacts

Karthik / team — quick status: I exported the rotation log for customer-managed keys and pulled the HSM attestation. Initial artifacts attached below. One outstanding item is the HSM "seal" audit (third-party check) — AZ HSM vendor is finalizing a short attestation which we expect in ~48 hours.

Attached: 
- hsm_attestation_2026-03.pdf (pdf) — vendor-signed attestation, includes CA chain.
- rotation_log_2025-05-2026-05.csv (csv) — audit export (key_id, event, timestamp, operator_id, action, wrap_algorithm).
- byok_onboarding_checklist_v1.4.pdf (pdf) — onboarding steps for customer BYOK, includes consent/contract references.

Notes/clarifications: 
- Rotation logs include a hashed key identifier (we do not export raw key material). Operator IDs are internal SAML IDs; we can provide a mapping or redacted list per your preference.
- Our KMS enforces a dual-approval policy for manual rotations of root wrapping keys; automated periodic rotations for intermediate wrapping keys are enabled per policy.
- Transport: all wrap/unwrap RPCs between services use mTLS with TLS1.2+ and ECDHE ciphers; we include a short cipher list in the ZIP.

If you need the raw audit pipeline output (larger CSV) or an additional signed statement, tell me and I'll prepare it.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
Attachment: hsm_attestation_2026-03.pdf (pdf); rotation_log_2025-05-2026-05.csv (csv); byok_onboarding_checklist_v1.4.pdf (pdf)
From: audits@fincore.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — BYOK/HSM Evidence for FinCore SIG+SOC2 Review

Karthik / Irene / Laura — thank you for the quick turnaround and the artifacts sent so far. A few follow-ups to close our checklist: 

1) Can you provide a one-paragraph signed statement (PDF) confirming that BYOK key material is never exported in plaintext from an HSM, and indicating which roles (by SAML group name) have wrap/unwrap authority?
2) For rotation logs, can you confirm whether rotations for intermediate wrapping keys are fully automated (no human operator) or if there is an operator-initiated step? If operator-initiated, please highlight the dual-approval controls.
3) Please include the specific TLS cipher suites used for inter-service key transport (we need the exact OpenSSL/TLS names).

If you can deliver these clarifications (short PDFs or a single "clarifications.pdf") by Monday 2026-05-25 EOB, we should be able to mark FinCore's review as "evidence complete" and proceed with our SIG assessment.

Regards,
Maria Garcia
Security Audit Lead
FinCore Systems
Attachment: fincore_followup_questions.pdf (pdf)
